name: GdGenesis
description: AI decoration generator for the editor. Select blocks, type a prompt, get deco.

ai-mode.name: AI Mode
ai-mode.description:
<cy>Auto</c>: uses Claude when an API key is set, otherwise the instant offline generator.
<cy>Claude API</c>: always asks Claude (needs a key).
<cy>Offline</c>: never goes online, always instant.

api-key.name: Claude API Key
api-key.description: Your API key from <cy>console.anthropic.com</c>. It is stored on this device only and sent only to api.anthropic.com.

model.name: Claude Model
model.description: <cy>Haiku</c> is the fastest and best for the under-3-second target.

timeout.name: AI Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: If Claude takes longer than this, GdGenesis switches to the offline generator so you never wait long.

key-activation.name: Key Activation
key-activation.description: Open GdGenesis with a key in the editor <cy>instead of</c> the pause-menu button.

activation-key.name: Activation Key
activation-key.description: The key that opens GdGenesis in the editor.

main-channel.name: Main Deco Color Channel
main-channel.description: Color channel used for the main deco color.

color-triggers.name: Add Color Triggers
color-triggers.description: Places two color triggers just before the deco that set the deco channels to the prompt's colors.

deco-group.name: Put Deco In Group
deco-group.description: Group ID given to all generated deco. <cy>0</c> = no group.

max-objects.name: Max Objects Per Generate
max-objects.description: Upper limit on how many objects one Generate can add.

select-result.name: Select Generated Deco
select-result.description: On: the new deco is selected afterwards. Off: your original blocks stay selected so you can Undo and generate again.

learn-deco.name: Reuse Selected Deco
learn-deco.description: If your selection includes deco objects (like glow pieces), GdGenesis reuses them in the design.

custom-ids.name: Custom Deco IDs
custom-ids.description: Comma-separated object IDs GdGenesis can scatter (for example your favourite glow pieces). Used when the prompt says <cy>custom</c>.

owner-lock.name: Litchin-Only Lock
owner-lock.description: GdGenesis only opens when you're logged into the <cg>Litchin</c> account (or logged out).
